title: First severe case of bird flu detected in US, CDC confirms - Fox News
snippet: Severe case of H5N1 bird flu detected in US, CDC confirms | Fox News Fox News FOX News Go Fox News The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention said on Wednesday that a patient has been hospitalized with a severe case of H5N1 infection in Louisiana, marking the first known instance of a severe human illness linked to the bird flu virus in the United States. The CDC said that partial viral genome data from the infected patient shows that the virus belongs to the D1.1 genotype, recently detected in wild birds and poultry in the United States and in recent human cases in British Columbia, Canada, and Washington state.
